question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f19bcf5a54146655d892434b9e155c63b8d774eee28ad4387bbd0a5aed05594.png]
solution:
The logic here followed is

1) The darker portion moves from the outer to the inner diagram.

2) The central figure 90 degree in anti clockwise direction.

3) Outer polygonal decreases it's number of sides by 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/637c271390085fe67f1dc07b6a8c34a00397f8c1a133932f034287da10d44479.png] 

Only option(2) shows the correct answer.

Hence, the correct option is** option(2)**
